overview.heading: Drone and camera work — from weddings to business spaces.
overview.lead: Camera Motion is a video production crew from Belgrade. We film weddings, properties, celebrations and promo material for companies — with a drone from the air and a camera on the ground. We work in Belgrade and the surrounding area, and we arrange shoots elsewhere in Serbia and the region separately.
overview.editingNote: Every service includes full editing in Adobe Premiere Pro — the cut, the color and the sound. We can also edit footage you filmed yourself, by arrangement.
overview.photographyNote: Photography is coming to every service soon — get in touch if you need it on your next shoot.

weddings.excerpt: The whole day, from getting ready to the first dance, in a cinematic rhythm. The camera catches the emotion, the drone the church, the venue and the landscape. Vows and speeches are recorded with wireless microphones.
weddings.placeholder: shot: the couple in golden hour

realEstate.excerpt: Apartments, houses, villas and business spaces for Booking, Airbnb and agencies. One drone flight shows the location and the surroundings, while calm interior shots show the space as it really is. The material is ready for your listing and social media right away.
realEstate.placeholder: shot: drone flight over a villa with a pool

events.excerpt: Christenings, birthdays, conferences, performances and sports events. We film the flow and the atmosphere, without stepping into the frame and without interrupting the programme. You get a short spot, and by arrangement a longer film of the whole event.

promo.excerpt: For restaurants, salons, building sites, production floors and small businesses. A short spot that shows the space, the people and what you do. We also make a vertical version for Reels and Stories.
promo.placeholder: shot: promo filming inside a venue

fpv.excerpt: One unbroken flight through a space — through doorways, hallways and between trees. A shot a standard drone and camera simply cannot make. We do it on its own or as an add-on to any other service.
fpv.placeholder: shot: FPV flight through a house

weddings.title: Wedding videography
weddings.heading: Your day deserves a film you'll still watch in ten years.
weddings.lead: We arrive early, stay until the first dance and spend the whole day with you — quietly. The camera captures the emotion, the drone the setting and the atmosphere, and the edit turns it into a story with a beginning and an end.
weddings.placeholder: photo: the couple in golden hour
weddings.ctaPrimary: Check if your date is free

camera.title: Cinematic camera
camera.description: Fast lenses and a soft background — faces in focus, guests in the atmosphere. The camera holds up late in the evening too, when the lights in the venue go down.

gimbal.title: Gimbal
gimbal.description: Smooth movement through the venue, with no shake and without stepping into the frame. That way the spontaneous moments stay exactly as they happened.

drone.title: Drone
drone.description: The church, the venue and the landscape from the air — flown by a pilot registered with the Civil Aviation Directorate, in line with its rules. On request we add an FPV flight through the venue.

sound.title: Clean sound
sound.description: Wireless microphones on the vows, the speeches and the toasts. We also take the feed from the band's mixer, together with ambient microphones, and mix everything in post — just let the band know in advance.

packages.heading: Packages
packages.intro: All prices are starting prices and depend on the location and the length of the day. We put the quote together after a short conversation.
packages.note: If you need something outside the packages, get in touch — we'll write a separate quote. We film weddings in Belgrade and the surrounding area; for weddings further afield we arrange the details separately.

features.fullEdit: Edited film of the whole day

features.highlights: "Best moments" film, 4–6 min, set to music

features.fpv: FPV flight through the venue and the first dance
features.staticCamera: Static camera in the church (the full ceremony)

options.heading: Add-ons
options.intro: Added to any package by arrangement — alongside the drone and camera work on the day.

prewedding.title: Pre-wedding shoot
prewedding.description: A separate session before the wedding, for when the day itself leaves no time for calm shots of just the two of you. We pick the date around the weather forecast.

staticCamera.title: Extra static camera
staticCamera.description: One more angle recording without a break — the ceremony, the speeches or the first dance, with nothing missed.

storage.title: Extended footage storage
storage.description: We keep the raw footage after delivery too, so you can ask for another cut or a single shot later on.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.intro: You get the edited film digitally — no waiting for the post and no picking up a drive.

items.digital: A download link in full quality, plus versions ready for social media.
items.backup: We recommend copying the film to an external drive right away — the download link doesn't stay up forever.
items.timeline: We agree the delivery time and the deposit before the shoot and put them in writing.

events.title: Events
events.heading: Moments that don't happen twice — filmed the way they happened.
events.lead: Filming celebrations and events: birthdays, christenings, coming-of-age parties, sports and corporate events. With a camera on the ground and a drone in the air, we capture the atmosphere, the emotions and the details nobody has time to notice on the day.

coverage.heading: What we cover
coverage.intro: We make event videos in Belgrade and the surrounding area — from family celebrations to tournaments and conferences. For events further afield we arrange the details separately.

private.title: Private celebrations
private.description: Birthdays, christenings and coming-of-age parties — the toasts, the cake, the dancing and the guests, without staging or posing.

sports.title: Sports events
sports.description: Tournaments and matches from several angles — we catch the action on the court with a camera, and the venue, the stands and the crowd from the air.

corporate.title: Corporate gatherings
corporate.description: Conferences, company celebrations and staff get-togethers — the speeches, the atmosphere and the people, ready for your website and social media.

performances.title: Performances
performances.description: Concerts, plays and recitals — we film the programme without interrupting it or blocking the audience's view.

how.heading: How we film
how.intro: We follow the event quietly, from the side — guests relax and the footage stays natural.

camera.title: Camera on a gimbal
camera.description: Smooth shots from the ground, close to the people: the emotions, the details and the moments that last a second.

drone.title: Drone
drone.description: The location and the crowd from the air — the venue, the beach or the court in a single shot. Drone footage of birthdays and other celebrations is flown by a pilot registered with the Civil Aviation Directorate, in line with its rules.

discreet.title: Discreet filming
discreet.description: We don't interrupt the programme or ask guests to pose. The crew moves quietly, so the real atmosphere stays on film.

delivery.heading: Delivery
delivery.intro: After the event you get the edited film digitally, ready to share.

fpv.title: FPV footage
fpv.heading: One shot that flies where others can't.
fpv.lead: An FPV drone flies through doorways, down hallways and between trees — in one unbroken shot, with no cuts. We offer FPV filming in Belgrade and the surrounding area, on its own or as an add-on to any of our services.
fpv.placeholder: shot: FPV flight through the front door of a house

about.heading: What is FPV
about.intro: FPV stands for first-person view: the pilot sees exactly what the drone's camera sees, as if sitting inside it.

firstPerson.title: Flying in first person
firstPerson.description: The pilot wears goggles with a live feed from the drone and guides it precisely, inch by inch, through narrow gaps.

avata.title: DJI Avata 2
avata.description: A small drone with guards around the propellers, built for flying indoors and through tight spaces. When needed, it also flies classic shots outdoors.

oneTake.title: One flight, one take
oneTake.description: Instead of a string of shots, one dynamic cinematic flight that takes the viewer through the space as if they were flying themselves.

uses.heading: Where we use it
uses.intro: FPV drone footage works best wherever a space needs to be experienced, not just seen.

realEstate.title: Property
realEstate.description: A drone flight through the building, from the entrance to the terrace in a single shot. Guests or buyers see the layout as if they were walking through it.

celebrations.title: Weddings and celebrations
celebrations.description: The opening shot of the film — a flight through the hall, the church or the garden in one go, before the programme begins.

venues.title: Venues and businesses
venues.description: A restaurant, hotel or gym from the entrance to the last corner. A short flight that instantly shows what it's like to visit you.

sports.title: Sport
sports.description: An angle nobody else has — the drone follows the action from the side of the court or track and captures the speed and the excitement.

weather.title: Weather conditions
weather.description: Outdoors, a flight depends on wind and rain, so we check the forecast before the shoot and don't fly when conditions aren't safe.
